name: Dndvvv Analytics Player
author: dndvvv

sections.description:
Dndvvv Analytics Player is a powerful, self-hosted alternative to expensive third-party video platforms. Designed specifically for marketers and content creators, it provides a seamless viewing experience optimized for high conversions and deep analytical insights.

All features, including the audience retention heatmaps, custom player colors, and aspect ratios, are completely free and GPLv2 compatible!

Key Features

  • Advanced Audience Retention Heatmaps: Track exactly where viewers drop off with 1% precision. The plugin aggregates this data and displays visual charts directly in your WordPress dashboard under Tools > Dndvvv Analytics.
  • HLS Adaptive Streaming: Fully supports .m3u8 manifests via hls.js with an automatic quality selector.
  • Smart Autoplay: Features an intelligent “Tap to Unmute” overlay for mobile and desktop, ensuring videos autoplay silently where required by browsers without losing engagement.
  • Page Builder Support: Includes native Gutenberg blocks and Elementor widgets for drag-and-drop integration.
  • Flexible Aspect Ratios: Easily switch between horizontal (16:9), vertical (9:16), square (1:1), or standard (4:3) layouts – all for free!
  • Custom Branding: Pick any primary color to match your theme.
  • Self-Hosted Analytics: No external tracking scripts. All data is securely stored within your WordPress database via lightweight REST API endpoints.
sections.faq:
Do I need a third-party video host?

You can use any hosting provider that supplies direct MP4 or HLS (.m3u8) links. We recommend Bunny.net or Cloudflare Stream for affordable and fast HLS delivery.

Does it support Elementor?

Yes! The plugin comes with a dedicated Elementor widget. Just drag, drop, and paste your video URL.

Where do I see the heatmap analytics?

Go to your WordPress Admin dashboard and navigate to Tools > Dndvvv Analytics. Click on any video title to see its detailed retention chart.

  • Removed all restrictions – all premium features are now free for everyone.
